availableCommands.name: $app-6a3293e129088191abf0875820e839da:higgsfield
availableCommands.description: Resolve and route Higgsfield slash commands. Activate for a command invocation such as /ugc-video, /faceless-video, /ad-multiplier or /hero-shot, including a bare command, an unfamiliar command in Higgsfield context, or a command with missing media inputs. Resolve the route before asking for inputs or starting a generic workflow. Also use for named Higgsfield presets, preset or command browsing, and requests to open, connect or work in Higgsfield Video Editor/Katana, even without a slash. Exclude unrelated apps' commands, URL paths, quoted or translated commands, explicitly negated invocations, and ordinary media requests without a preset or command. Browsing does not authorize generation.

availableCommands.name: $app-6a3293e129088191abf0875820e839da:website-builder
availableCommands.description: Build and publish a complete website, web app or browser game on Higgsfield, or edit/redeploy an existing Higgsfield-hosted site. Use when the requested deliverable is that hosted product or a change to it. Components, snippets and fixes for a user's existing local codebase remain repository work; mentioning React, a website or a UI element does not request a hosted build. Exclude copywriting, external-site review, standalone media and read-only site administration. After a valid activation, collect missing product type and scope.

availableCommands.name: $app-6a3c407853888191beddc2151c2b6f8b:agent-email-inbox

availableCommands.name: $app-6a3c407853888191beddc2151c2b6f8b:react-email

availableCommands.name: $app-6a3c407853888191beddc2151c2b6f8b:resend-cli
